It is important to note that Harbor Analytics estimates the new queue could reduce median response time by 12%. This is a forecast, not an observed result. Furthermore, the estimate comes from a 6-week pilot involving 16 participants; allocation was not random, and no estimate of long-term savings is available.

The pilot did not evaluate accessibility. The team should not expand deployment until that review is complete. Moreover, Lena Ortiz described the proposal as "promising, but unproven." Details are in the [pilot note](https://example.com/pilot).
